summary: The size toggle behavior is implemented and validated, but the new swap control is not exposed as an accessible button. Please fix the toggle semantics before merge.

comments.body: This is an interactive control, but it renders as an `svg` with no `role`, no `tabIndex`, and no keyboard activation. The live DOM for `toggle-denomination` is `{ tag: "svg", role: null, tabIndex: -1, ariaLabel: "Toggle size denomination" }`, so keyboard users cannot focus or activate the denomination toggle. Please render this as a real button/icon button, or add equivalent button semantics and Enter/Space handling.
